title: Flat illustration / Usage

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content area, default interactive state

slide_intent: Keep bold shapes readable in motion so expression does not turn into ambiguous overlaps or disorienting movement.
strategic_value: Confident silhouettes and restrained transitions can extend IBM’s flat illustration character across digital and print contexts.
demonstration: Applications lead into motion examples comparing performance, transparency, camera translation and adaptation of shaded artwork.
practical_value: Use flat forms for expressive action while preserving their geometry and simplifying effects when necessary.

content_islands.name: Application family
content_islands.spec: Group publications and screen examples above the motion guidance.

content_islands.name: Performance
content_islands.spec: Introduce the large green animation frame and two character-performance examples.

content_islands.name: Transparency and translation
content_islands.spec: Pair approved and rejected fades and camera movements with explicit captions.

content_islands.name: Adaptation
content_islands.spec: Compare the original shaded finger with a simplified version prepared for animation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects bold color and graphic quality to dynamic content and personality.
reference_purposes.Expression: Large filled shapes and saturated fields carry the flat style.
reference_purposes.Application: Comparisons demonstrate performance, fades, camera behavior and adaptations for animation.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source discourages exaggeration, bounces and smears, and rejects distracting camera moves or unintended translucent intersections.
